name: OR-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Maxine Dexter running with over $1M raised
Republican challenger Loran Ayles has no reported fundraising
model.rationale: The D+24 district fundamentals, Dexter's incumbency and fundraising edge, and prediction markets pricing her near 96% all point to a safe Democratic hold, so the forecast stays at the baseline margin of about 26 points.
model.watch: Any late polling or surge in challenger fundraising showing the race tightening would be the main signal to revisit.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Portland-area OR-03 is a heavily Democratic district with a D+24 partisan lean, and first-term incumbent Maxine Dexter is running for reelection. She has raised more than $1 million, while Republican challenger Loran Ayles reports no fundraising figures, leaving him with little visible financial support. No expert ratings or general-election polls are available for this race.
Prediction markets price Dexter's chances at roughly 96%, consistent with the district's fundamentals. With no evidence of competitive spending or polling, the race is rated Safe Democratic, with an expected margin in the mid-20s and moderate uncertainty given the absence of direct polling.
